title: Permanent utility tie-in beside the Canada Line
summary: The Broadway Subway project scheduled two nights of utility installation beside the existing Broadway–City Hall station. This was construction work, not a change to Canada Line passenger service.

title: Evergreen Extension opens to passengers
summary: The Millennium Line began carrying passengers between Lougheed Town Centre and Lafarge Lake–Douglas.

title: Broadway Subway receives construction funding
summary: Ottawa and B.C. announced funding for the six-station extension from VCC–Clark to Arbutus.

title: Port Coquitlam outlines a feasibility study
summary: Mayor Brad West described a possible Millennium Line branch near Coquitlam Central. The city had not selected station sites.

title: Major construction begins on Broadway
summary: The Province announced the start of major construction following site preparation and utility relocation.

title: Two North Shore rail alternatives modelled
summary: Researchers compared Gold (Waterfront) and Purple (Metrotown) using SkyTrain as a modelling assumption. Neither was a technology decision.

title: Mayors’ Council records its UBC route decision
summary: Published meeting papers record the April vote on the horizontal alignment and station areas. Vertical alignment and funding remained unresolved.

title: Province approves Surrey–Langley project funding
summary: The released business case and government funding commitments cover the Expo Line extension to Langley City Centre.

title: Cambie infill remains a planning item
summary: A City update revisits the adopted corridor plan. Its planning reports consider potential Canada Line stations at 33rd and 57th; provision is not project funding.

title: Capstan opens on the Canada Line
summary: Passenger service began at Capstan, between Bridgeport and Aberdeen on the Richmond branch.

title: Guideway columns rise along Fraser Highway
summary: B.C. reported that major works had begun in November 2024 and columns were visible at multiple sites. The start day was not specified.

title: Port Coquitlam reports business-plan work
summary: The City’s 2025 annual report records work with TransLink on a SkyTrain business plan. It does not announce construction funding or a station location.

title: All eight Surrey–Langley stations under construction
summary: Six station foundations were complete. Work continued at 152 Street and began at Willowbrook; Fleetwood and Green Timbers had visible above-ground structures.

title: Train testing starts on the elevated guideway
summary: Test vehicles were running on the extension. The tests do not constitute the start of passenger service.

title: Oak–VGH prepares for traffic-deck removal
summary: The project scheduled a utility inspection for August 23 and a traffic shift for August 27 to make room for deck removal.

title: Backfilling brings truck traffic to East 1st Avenue
summary: Crews planned gravel deliveries to fill the space between the station roof and the surface.

title: Fall advisory details guideway and station work
summary: The project office outlined rail installation, guideway assembly and station construction for September through November.

title: Surrey–Langley extension named for Dave Barrett
summary: The Province named the extension after the former premier. It remains part of the Expo Line.

title: Final track installation approaches on Broadway
summary: B.C. expected the remaining trackwork to finish that week. It also confirmed the traffic deck at Broadway–City Hall had been removed in August.

title: Langley Launcher reaches the eastern terminus
summary: The launching gantry reached Langley City Centre. B.C. reported guideway construction was roughly 65% complete.

title: Concrete pour scheduled at Fleetwood
summary: The project extended site hours for a continuous pour at the future station.

title: Longer shifts for concrete work at 152 Street
summary: The project scheduled extended hours on October 20 and 21 for continuous concrete work.

title: South Granville moves into deck removal
summary: A traffic shift was scheduled to make space for panel removal and backfilling. Interior finishing and equipment tests continued.

title: Sunday shifts for two station structures
summary: Rebar, concrete and structural work prompted additional shifts at Bakerview–166 Street and Hillcrest–184 Street.

title: Arbutus prepares to remove its remaining deck
summary: The project scheduled a traffic shift on Broadway so crews could remove deck panels and girders on the south side.

title: Oak–VGH prepares a permanent water connection
summary: Crews planned overnight preparation on Broadway while road restoration continued above the station.

title: Permanent utility work resumes at Hemlock
summary: South Granville crews planned overnight utility locating and pipe work alongside backfilling and road restoration.

title: Hillcrest schedules a continuous concrete pour
summary: The project announced an extended shift for structural concrete at Hillcrest–184 Street.

title: Water-main tie-in advances at Oak–VGH
summary: A new notice detailed two weeks of overnight work to finish preparation and install the connections.

title: Temporary supports to come down at Clayton
summary: The project scheduled removal of supports from completed concrete structures. Station construction continued.

title: Interior finishes go in at Great Northern Way
summary: Crews were fitting wall tiles, ceilings and masonry. Roof waterproofing and backfilling were next on the fall work program.

title: Bakerview schedules continuous concrete work
summary: The project announced an early start on November 9 for a concrete pour at the future station.

title: Surrey directs staff to advance SkyTrain to Newton
summary: Council adopted a King George Boulevard extension as a priority and directed staff to advance it. The motion did not fund construction.

title: Permanent water main scheduled at City Hall
summary: The project announced five nights of water-main installation between Cambie and Yukon as the street above the station is rebuilt.

title: Track installation moves along Industrial Avenue
summary: The project scheduled a November 24 road closure for concrete work and track installation on the elevated guideway.

title: Sidewalk rebuilding moves to Broadway–City Hall
summary: The project scheduled sidewalk demolition for November 23. Pedestrian access will be detoured as restoration continues into 2027.

title: Premier reiterates commitment to Newton extension
summary: The incoming premier cited Newton in naming a parliamentary secretary for TransLink. He did not announce construction funding or a start date.
